_comment: repoUrl is the benchmark repository; links to it appear only when repoPublic is true. The site repo, the pipeline and internal repos are never linked. Feedback goes through feedback.html (templated mailto to contactEmail).
subtitle: Live, public screening for automated-research attacks on peer review
mission: Red-flag Research is a research project from OpenLAIR that screens conference submissions for automated-research attacks, starting with paper laundering in ICLR 2027. It checks each submission against earlier public papers and flags close matches that lack clear credit, so a person can compare the two side by side. A flag is a lead, not a verdict.
